# Synthetic fixtures

`synthetic-courses.xlsx` is a minimal OOXML workbook created locally for parser tests. Its single row is invented (合成数学 / Monday / 08:00–09:30 / weeks 1–16 odd / A101). It contains no personal data, macros, external links or model output.

All HTTP responses in the TypeScript tests are synthetic protocol fixtures. No live DeepSeek request was made, and no API key was supplied.
